findings.evidence: REGRESSION (re-opened). Run-2 and run-3 both reported 'all 10 network.json files are empty arrays (zero 4xx/5xx)'. Run-4 has 95 4xx events in network.json (sum across the 3 active-capture states): state 01-pos-empty has 44× POST /api/frontend/csp-report → 429, state 02-pos-cart-with-frites has 35× POST /api/frontend/csp-report → 429, state 01-kds-pile-baseline has 14× POST /api/frontend/csp-report → 429. Plus 2× 403 in state 01 (/api/admin/fiscal/z-report and /api/admin/stock/low-alerts — known role-permission gating, expected). The CSP-report 429 storm is fired by the browser on every CSP violation; the rate-limit then rejects each report. No corresponding [role=alert]/.toast in DOM (cat 6 'silent' criterion technically met), but per protocol cat 10 these 429s are not in the documented allowlist (the allowlist covers 401-on-logout, 422-on-form-validation, 304-noop). Marked P2 because the endpoint is internal-only and the 429 is intentional throttling, but the regression itself is real (zero entries → 95 entries between run-3 and run-4).
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) cap the SPA's CSP-report fetch frequency client-side (debounce to 1 every 5s instead of one per violation), or (b) reduce the CSP report-only directives so fewer violations fire (the dashboard image-load 403 cascade was the original source per run-1 B-008), or (c) re-enable the 204-noop short-circuit that landed in run-2 if it was reverted. Suspicion: the run-2 fix was reverted as part of the appEnv injection commit between run-3 and run-4.

convergence_verdict: NOT CONVERGED — wave B is GREEN on the P0 gate (4th consecutive zero) but RED on every other dimension. Run-4 closed exactly one finding (B-010 aria-label i18n leaks, the new P1 from run-3) — confirming F3.1 fix is solid and F3.3 lane-rename + order-282 visibility both PASS. However the cycle simultaneously REGRESSED on two previously-closed findings: B-003 (KDS-side reconnect banner that runs-2/3 fix missed because it gated only the POS-tracker rt-warn banner, not the global ConnectionStatusBanner above the FoodKing logo) and B-008 (CSP-report 429 storm: 0 → 93 entries). Three findings (B-004/B-007/B-009) are now in their 4TH consecutive heal cycle, exceeding CLAUDE.md §8's 3-cycle ceiling. Per the doctrine, the next cycle MUST either land definitive fixes for all three OR formally escalate to human gate. Net delta vs run-3: P1 stayed at 1 (B-010 closed, B-003 reopened); P2 went from 3 to 4 (B-008 reopened). The fact that an appEnv injection commit between run-3 and run-4 simultaneously fixed F3.1/F3.2/F3.3 AND regressed B-003 + B-008 is a strong signal of insufficient regression-test coverage of the previously-closed findings — recommend adding to the spec: assertions for `class="connection-status-banner"` count == 0 in KDS states AND for csp-report response count == 0 in network.json, so future appEnv-shaped commits cannot silently re-open these. Recommendation: ESCALATE B-004/B-007/B-009 to human gate AND require run-5 to re-close B-003 + B-008 before declaring wave B converged.
